correctness.rationale: PASS: The linear normal form (1) follows directly from the four-element quandle table. W=Ann_right(E) and its right scalar action force preservation of W and augmentation. All automorphisms therefore have block form (A,C;0,B). Multiplicativity requires B m(h,k)=m(Ah,Ak); diagonal evaluations give ac=bd=0, invertibility plus augmentation forces A=I or the swap P, and off-diagonal evaluations force B=A. Every C is then allowed. This completely establishes the group and finite-field orders for arbitrary characteristic-two fields. A package-local standard-library verifier exhaustively checks all 65,536 binary linear maps (32 automorphisms, exactly the predicted set) and checks all 512 and 8192 constructed automorphisms over GF4 and GF8.

value.rationale: PASS: The 2026 primary article highlights incomplete even-order dihedral quandle algebra automorphism theory. The first nontrivial even-order instance acquires a four-parameter shear symmetry group in the otherwise excluded characteristic two. A complete description over every characteristic-two field (including infinite fields), an intrinsic annihilator reduction, and exact finite-field orders resolve a motivated natural structural invariant rather than a sample calculation or routine restatement. It does not purport to solve larger even-order cases.
